reference.title: Review, Compare, Stash, Stage, and Commit Actions
reference.shortdesc: Actions for reviewing, stashing, staging, and committing local changes.

strow.stentry: Opens the selected file, folder, or submodule.
File area contextual menu
Opens the file in the compare editor to show the changes.
File area contextual menu, double-click
Compares the selected resource with its repository version, without going through the staging workflow.
Project view Git submenu
Shelves all uncommitted changes and cleans the working copy.
Stash drop-down, Git menu
Shelves only the selected files (both their staged and unstaged changes), reverting them to the last committed state. Unavailable when the selection contains conflicts.
File area contextual menu
Opens the stashes dialog box to apply or remove stashes.
Stash drop-down, Git menu
Restores the selected stash to the working copy.
Stashes dialog box
Delete / Delete all
Removes the selected stash, or clears every stash.
Stashes dialog box
Moves the selected files to the staged area.
Git Staging view; Git History view uncommitted changes row
Moves all changed files to the staged area.
Git Staging view
Moves the selected files back to the unstaged area.
Git Staging view; Git History view uncommitted changes row
Moves all staged files back to the unstaged area.
Git Staging view
Reverts the selected files to their last committed state.
File area contextual menu; Git History view uncommitted changes row
Records the staged changes as a commit in the local repository.
Git Staging view
Drafts a commit message from the staged changes, using .
Commit message toolbar
Reuses a message from a recent commit.
Commit message toolbar
Adds the staged changes to the most recent local commit, or edits its message.
Commit message toolbar
Pushes the commit to the remote immediately after committing.
Commit message toolbar
